source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique IB TBD identity; OOB counterpart defines an isolated temporary BMC-generated ARP suspension lifecycle.

source_snapshot.procedure: During Test TBD; generic pre-step requests configuration verification and log clearing.

historical_reviews.related_source_cases: OOB counterpart supplies a package/confirmation-gated temporary suspension workflow.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 makes channel/method/duration Project inputs; ED-35 preserves state-change coverage; ED-38 no retry.

original_test_intent: Temporarily suspend the approved BMC-generated ARP behavior on one isolated LAN channel, observe the exact network effect, then resume or restore normal behavior without losing management access.
original_method: Use the vendor-supported ARP-control action only after scope, duration/expiry, expected gratuitous/response behavior, traffic monitors and independent recovery are approved.
manual_activity: Network owner approves scope/duration; operator confirms traffic capture and independent console/OOB recovery immediately before suspension.
safety_requirements: Do not change IP/DHCP as fallback

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects guessed execution; paired OOB history makes it conditional on vendor schema and approval.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Vendor-approved bounded ARP-control runner with state readback, watchdog expiry and independent traffic/reachability probes.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture baseline ARP traffic and sessions, confirm an isolated channel, suspend the exact approved ARP behavior once, observe bounded traffic/reachability and expiry, then resume/restore and prove final state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines safe functional coverage without editing the TBD Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only ARP inventory cannot replace the suspend/resume behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: ARP suspension can isolate the BMC or disrupt neighbor caches.

project_override_considerations: Any vendor tool must expose equivalent scope, present state, expiry/resume and recovery evidence.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master gives no command, ARP type, channel, duration or expected result and requests clearing logs, so the title alone cannot support safe execution.

blocked_analysis.analysis: OOB history establishes a legitimate temporary control lifecycle; exact vendor selector, target and recovery are readiness inputs rather than an irresolvable contradiction.

review_improvement: Retains real suspension coverage with a watchdog, traffic evidence and explicit recovery instead of substituting read-only state.
independent_technical_reasoning: The action is network-disruptive but bounded and reversible when the vendor contract, isolated channel and independent recovery exist. Therefore REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION is more accurate than permanent BLOCKED.
